name: ModelVariant847_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant847_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (two model points leave trails of four-point stars while the ambient level dips, then two bursts in front of the slot each draw a widening ring, a double star, embers, sparks and debris, with a camera shake and an optional full-screen flash marking each burst before the ambient comes back); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the rings, debris and embers and packs four texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the delay, 4 once at the first burst, 1 once at the second burst, 2 once the ambient has recovered and the burst colour and flash have faded, and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-864 and 961 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
